doc.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Why he was called for unusual music
summary: His reputation for being on time and studying the music led to difficult calls.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: It seems that [at] this period of your career you were doing a lot of things different.

Yeah, sure, I was right in it. It all happened because I had developed this reputation of being a guy who would take care of business: be on the gig on time, take the music home and really work on it, and hang in there. If people had something that was out of the ordinary, they would call me to do it. It was not because I was the best trumpet player around, but I would give it my best.
